title: Meet the Breadboard
subject: Circuits
description: Where wires go, and why the holes are connected the way they are.

quiz.prompt: How many holes are connected together in one terminal strip row?
quiz.explain: Each row connects five holes on one side of the center channel. The other five are a separate group.

quiz.prompt: What is the channel down the middle of the breadboard for?
choices: It keeps a chip's two rows of legs from shorting together
It's where the power goes in
quiz.explain: Chips straddle the channel so each leg lands in its own isolated row. Without the gap, every leg would short to the one opposite it.

quiz.prompt: Your LED leg is one row off from where you meant to put it. What happens?
choices: Nothing tells you — the circuit just doesn't work
quiz.explain: This is why the tug test matters. A breadboard never warns you about a wrong connection, so you have to check it yourself.
